$comment: What of public/ ships in each game's dist/<id>/ (read by vite.config.ts at build time and by tools/licence/audit.mjs --game). Every build drops `devOnly` (DEV-only assets such as the demo Spine rig), every other game's assets/<id>/ folder, and the game's own meta.json `publicExclude` (shared public assets that game never loads). Paths are relative to public/.
